remarks: Off deadline today 3/9/2026 at 6PM! Welcome to East Norwalk-where coastal charm and everyday convenience come together. Built in 2021, this turnkey, move-in-ready end-unit townhome offers 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a 2-car garage, with modern finishes throughout.  Inside, enjoy hardwood floors on every level, a bright open layout, and a stylish kitchen featuring quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances-perfect for everyday living and effortless entertaining. The home spans three floors, featuring a private primary suite with an en-suite bath and a walk-in closet, creating a true retreat. The advantages of newer construction shine here, including energy-efficient systems, current building standards, and the peace of mind that comes with newer mechanicals and appliances-all designed for comfort and lower operating costs.  Just minutes from Long Island Sound, beaches, boating, scenic walking routes, dog parks, and local favorites, this location makes it easy to enjoy the best of shoreline living. Commuters will love the proximity to Metro-North with New York City reachable in under an hour, plus quick access to the dining and entertainment of South Norwalk (SoNo) and the renowned restaurants, shopping, and train station in Westport.  A modern, low-maintenance home in one of Norwalk's most desirable coastal neighborhoods-this one checks every box.
